Excerpted from LEAH GARCHIK’S PERSONALS

June 30, 1999

REGIONAL SPECIALTIES

  • Guests at a fund-raising party at Richard Miller’s house in Tiburon on Saturday night for NORML (the National Organization for the Reform of Marijuana Laws) included George Zimmer, Ram Dass, Assemblywoman Audie Bock, San Francisco District Attorney Terence Hallinan and Eugene Schoenfeld, Personals’ informant. Founder Keith Stroup introduced Bock, who said, "Three words: I did inhale." She was followed by Tony Serra, who said, "I do inhale"; he was followed by another speaker, anonymous, who said, "I just inhaled."
